info.title: Tendr merchant API
info.description: Merchant integration endpoints. The secret key selects store and test/live mode. Dashboard, invoice-owner and AI management routes require user sessions and are documented separately. Source-reviewed against the implementation on 2026-11-10.

servers.description: Hosted API; use a tdr_test_ key while developing

bearerAuth.description: Server-side tdr_test_ or tdr_live_ secret API key. Never put it in a storefront bundle.

unit_amount.description: Decimal string; never a floating-point JSON number.

amount_currency.description: USD, supported ISO currency, or the exact configured settlement asset ID.

payment_link_id.description: Link whose settings and use limit apply.

theme_id.description: Store theme. Live checkout uses a published version.

hook_data.description: Integrator contract stores only: non-null JSON, at most 1,024 serialized UTF-8 bytes.
